name: Lei Zheng
bio: Zheng Lei has graduated from Zhejiang Institute of Media and Communication, majoring in Broadcasting and Hosting Art. He has been the host of the talk show of Zhejiang Radio and Television Group. In the 2006 in the CCTV Challenge Host Competition, he was the seventh in the country. Has been the host of the talk show of Zhejiang Radio and Television Group.

credits.title: Parallel Forest
credits.overview: A mother who lost her child happened to find the entrance to the parallel world after being chased by another self in the forest.
